Messages.Body:
Can he be damaged by Weather Control played by the minion possessing
Charnas? Errata says he cannot be damaged from host, but is
environmental damaged included in that?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <8sv5v2$7pf$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> Can Charnas the Imp be damaged by Weather Control played by the
> minion possessing Charnas?

Yes.

Weather control is considered to be "environmental" damage, or damage
that is not coming from the minion for purposes of Pulled Fangs,
Disarm, Memories of Mortality, and Charnas the Imp.

> Errata says he cannot be damaged from host, but is
> environmental damaged included in that?

It is not errata.
It is card text.
VTES Version appears below.

Charnas the Imp
Unique Retainer with 1 life.
Put Charnas on any minion.
The minion with this retainer takes
1 damage each time he or she untaps.
That minion cannot damage Charnas.
If the minion is burned, his or her
controlling Methuselah can put
Charnas on any minion.

Carpe Noctem.
